verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (logo, product, headline, CTA), but the product is shrunk to a tiny icon and there is a wide dead gap between the copy and the CTA. B jams the product against the top-left edge, puts the CTA in the middle of the banner so it competes with the headline, and pushes the logo to the far right, so the reading order is jumbled.

A has even margins and a logical flow, though the product is tiny and the space between the text and the CTA is empty. B has the same structure but the logo is crammed against the left edge, the CTA nearly touches the right edge and the product is cramped, so the margins are uneven and tight.
